title: Finding
description: One finding from any pass. Reviewers write rule_id, pass, line, quote, replacement, comment, and basis; lint adds id, col, certainty, note, and check; sgc findings adds id, severity, kind, status, and the fields after it.

rule_id.description: A guide rule ID, or a built-in PROOF-* or FACT-* ID

pass.description: The findings file's stem (lint, usage, usage-1, structure, voice, proof, facts); sgc findings sets it from the file name

quote.description: Copied exactly from the cited line

replacement.description: Replaces exactly the quote; null for a comment

id.description: L for lint (set by sgc lint), F for the rest (set by sgc findings)

col.description: 0-based column of the quote on its line

status.description: auto: checked in code (lint, facts), skips the verifier; pending: awaits a verdict; kept and revised: after sgc verdicts

suggestion.description: prefer severity, or an ai-drafting rule on a human draft

confirmed.description: Uncertain lint: true when the mechanical confirmer said it applies, null when no answer

moved_from.description: The cited line, when sgc findings re-anchored the quote
